reason: I'm not letting an AI answer my customers or send sales emails in my name when one wrong reply could cost me a client I spent years earning. And 99 euros a month for something I'd have to babysit is exactly the kind of subscription I end up cancelling.
objection: AI talking to my customers could damage my reputation, and I don't know what it will say when I'm not watching.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it run on the free plan in draft-only mode, where nothing goes to a customer until I approve it, and it actually saving me hours in the first month.
